title: 连接小题 AI 工具中心
description: 请填写从小题个人中心获取的 MCP Key。凭证仅保存在本机 WorkBuddy 配置中。
description_en: Enter the MCP Key from your XT account. The credential is stored only in your local WorkBuddy configuration.

fields.label: MCP Key
fields.description: 每位用户必须填写自己的 MCP Key，工具调用费用将计入该 Key 对应的钱包。
fields.description_en: Use your own MCP Key. Tool usage is charged to the wallet associated with that key.
